configuration.description: Exact <=8192-byte protected root-owned mode0400 /etc/serverware/native-shadow-driver-outgoing.json. Source-owned fresh allocation only: no endpoint/signing permission. The actual independent C9 signature must subsequently bind these exact runtime bytes and observed FD identities, then the original phase-two signature binds the full operation.

activationOriginal.description: Actual retained FD metadata for the independent C9 signer to place in its complete ordered activation inventory. Not caller assertions; no target FD ordinal is invented before the complete inventory is assembled.

activationOriginals.description: Exactly one fresh unconnected socket and one separately retained root O_RDONLY parent-directory FD for every filtered outgoing endpoint. Launch1/runtime5 yields30 entries, launch2/runtime6 yields28, launch3/runtime7 yields26, launch4/runtime8 yields24. Endpoint names sorted lexicographically after source-fixed native exclusions define bridge-outgoing-directory-0 through the last filtered ordinal. All original inode pairs remain distinct under existing strict C9/operation admission.
